name: Cusagh: La Fame
source:
In the summer of 1792, the Beast of Cusago terrorized Upper Milan, preying on children in the fields and forests. The panic ended only in autumn when the creature was supposedly stopped. 

Carlo Maria Borri, son of the hunting inspector, suspects the threat is not over – that the beast still hides somewhere, and its mysteries are far from solved.

[From [url=https://12-wolves.itch.io/cusaghlafame]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1792年夏天，库萨戈野兽袭击了上米兰，在田野和森林中捕食儿童。直到秋天，恐慌才结束，据说这种生物已经被阻止了。

狩猎督察的儿子卡洛·玛丽亚·博里 (Carlo Maria Borri) 怀疑威胁还没有结束——这只野兽仍然藏在某个地方，它的谜团还远未解开。

[来自[url=https://12-wolves.itch.io/cusaghlafame]Itch.io[/url]]
